description: Changes the UK delivery address of one IMPOSSIBREW order that has not left the warehouse. This tool makes no other change. The AI Brewer shows the exact change and makes it only after the customer replies yes. The message goes to the AI Brewer, the same assistant as on impossibrew.co.uk, which checks identity (email plus delivery postcode, or an order number starting EC plus either). message is the customer's own words. The first call has no conversationId; each result returns the conversationId that continues the same conversation across these order tools. The reply is the AI Brewer's complete answer.
name: change_delivery_address
title: Change delivery address
